prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create one clean3-by-3 gaze atlas from the supplied exact1536x840 nearest-neighbor reference grid. Each cell is one complete64x35 upper portrait at the same scale; output only a3x3 atlas with equal cells, no gutters, labels, text, borders, full-face duplicates, added padding or crop. The reference grid repeats the exact same original NPC079 upper half. Do not return nine identical eyes.

Keep the face, hair, skin, shadows, lighting, nose, background, and eyebrows unchanged. Preserve NPC079's own lowered inward-angled dark-brown brow shape exactly; do not raise, soften, straighten or thicken brows. Change only the tiny eye gaze features inside existing eye masks, with at most a one-native-pixel upper-lid adjustment as specified below. Keep both narrow shadowed eye openings, spacing and original lower-lid contours stable. Do not make eyes larger or rounder.

Preserve each original NPC079 olive-brown/gold iris and dark pupil as the same rigid native-pixel cluster: same width (about3 native pixels), pixel shape, pixel count, colors, tiny warm highlight and contrast. Never enlarge, stretch, round, repaint, brighten or saturate the cluster. Keep sclera tiny and source-like. No white crescents, giant whites, flash, new highlights or added detail. Preserve exact muted warm tan/brown skin, olive-gold iris, dark soft brown lid and hair palette and chunky pixel edges. No blur, smoothing, antialiasing, sharpening, color cast, expression change or head movement.

Required row-major gaze matrix: TOP UP-LEFT / UP / UP-RIGHT; MIDDLE LEFT / CENTER / RIGHT; BOTTOM DOWN-LEFT / DOWN / DOWN-RIGHT. Move both complete iris-pupil clusters together in the named screen direction, coherently across both eyes. Horizontal glances must read clearly. Diagonals combine horizontal and vertical movement.

At native64x35 size, move each TOP-row iris-pupil center2 pixels HIGHER than its matching MIDDLE-row direction. UP may raise only the upper-lid edge by at most1 native pixel if needed to keep the unchanged iris cluster readable. Do not move brows or lower lids. Move each BOTTOM-row iris-pupil center1 native pixel LOWER than its matching MIDDLE-row direction. DOWN may lower only the upper-lid edge by at most1 native pixel if needed; keep lower lids fixed. Do not fake vertical gaze by moving or darkening a lid over an unmoved iris. Let lids naturally cover the same unchanged cluster. Keep CENTER row iris-pupil clusters at original vertical position. Use equal horizontal displacement across rows: left2 pixels left, center0, right2 pixels right. Both eyes must agree on each direction.

Make vertical glances clearly different from left, center, and right at native scale while keeping identity and narrow eye anatomy. Return only the complete3x3 atlas.
